scope: Program-local audit of already sealed internal exact carriers plus source-applicable published fixed-palette/list-colouring carriers. This is not a claim to enumerate every polynomial graph algorithm in mathematics.

published_sources.title: On List Coloring and List Homomorphism of Permutation and Interval Graphs
published_sources.verified_claim: List Coloring is polynomial-time solvable on permutation graphs and interval graphs when the total number of colours is bounded.
published_sources.E2_effect: Expand C5 from permutation-only wording to PERMUTATION_OR_INTERVAL_BOUNDED_TOTAL_COLOR.

published_sources.title: List k-colouring P_t-free graphs: A Mim-width perspective
published_sources.verified_claim: For fixed k, List k-Colouring is polynomial on graph classes of bounded and quickly computable mim-width; the paper also proves quickly computable bounded mim-width for declared forbidden-subgraph classes and records the known P5-free List-k theorem.
published_sources.E2_effect: Confirm C6 and source-check a separate P5-free fixed-k carrier.

published_sources.title: On algorithmic applications of sim-width and mim-width of (H1,H2)-free graphs
published_sources.verified_claim: For every fixed k, List k-Colouring is polynomial-time solvable for graph classes whose sim-width is bounded and quickly computable.
published_sources.E2_effect: C6 must explicitly cover both mim-width and sim-width; no recognition/optimization shortcut is authorized without a source-produced decomposition.

published_sources.title: The structure and the number of P7-free bipartite graphs
published_sources.verified_claim: P7-free bipartite graphs admit the published recursive structural decomposition used in the current source inventory.
published_sources.E2_effect: Retain C7 only under exact P7-free bipartite preconditions.

published_sources.title: Sparse induced subgraphs in P7-free graphs of bounded clique number
published_sources.verified_claim: The paper explicitly notes that the Lozin-Zamaraev structure implies bounded mim-width for P7-free bipartite graphs and that a corresponding decomposition can be found efficiently.
published_sources.E2_effect: C7 is a decomposition route into C6 rather than an independent generic List-4 solver.

published_sources.title: Deciding k-colorability of P5-free graphs in polynomial time
published_sources.verified_claim: For every fixed k, the P5-free colouring algorithm is constructive; later source inventories explicitly record that the proof carries to List k-Colouring.
published_sources.E2_effect: Add C9 P5_FREE_FIXED_K_LIST_COLORING as a separate program-local escape class.

internal_reuse_audit.C1: B2B2-E K_k common-palette P7-free List-3 carrier.
internal_reuse_audit.C2: B2B2-C Q_ALL block factorization plus sealed FACTORIZED_FEEDBACK_INTERFACE_PORTFOLIO.
internal_reuse_audit.C5: E1 X_k bounded-total-colour permutation/chain carrier; published theorem also covers interval graphs.
internal_reuse_audit.C6: Source-produced bounded and quickly computable mim-width OR sim-width decomposition only; fixed-k List Coloring backend. No global width recognition/optimization assumption.
internal_reuse_audit.C7: Exact bipartite P7-free structural decomposition; operationally routes to C6 when the published decomposition preconditions are met.
internal_reuse_audit.C8: Any secondary exact decomposition inside connected Q_ALL must prove complete future R1/R2/source/reconstruction support separation; ordinary graph separation alone is insufficient.
internal_reuse_audit.C9: P5-free fixed-k List Coloring, source-applicable only after exact P5-freeness of every active future graph is certified.

calibration_matrix.K_k: C1 closes by common palette List-3.
calibration_matrix.X_k: C5 closes by bounded-colour chain/permutation List Coloring.
calibration_matrix.subdivided_wall: Does NOT justify C6 globally; the sealed wall family has unbounded mim-width, so C6 requires an actual bounded source-derived decomposition.

binding_addenda: C5 := bounded-total-colour List Coloring on permutation OR interval graphs.
C6 := bounded and quickly computable mim-width OR sim-width with an explicitly supplied/source-derived decomposition.
C7 := P7-free bipartite decomposition route feeding C6, not a generic solver.
audit_conclusion.promotion_rule: A future E3 candidate is UNCOVERED_BY_FROZEN_E2_CARRIER_LIST only after exact FAIL_TO_APPLY receipts for C1-C9 and any binding later addendum. UNCOVERED is not hardness.

firewalls: No claim that the audit enumerates every polynomial algorithm in graph theory.
No carrier applies by visual resemblance; every frozen precondition must be proved on the active future state class.
Bounded mim/sim-width is usable only with a polynomially obtainable decomposition.
Failure of all E2 carriers is OPEN_NO_KNOWN_CARRIER, not a lower bound.
